entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This will not only strengthen the..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will not only strengthen the bond between the monarchy and the divine but also foster a sense of righteousness and unity among our people."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Furthermore, as a religious leader..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, as a religious leader, I offer a profound comprehension of spiritual affairs and can provide invaluable guidance on both state and soul, guaranteeing the prosperity of our realm not just in worldly affairs but also in matters of the spirit."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""My second proposal, in addition to..."
entries.dialogueText: "My second proposal, in addition to the newly assigned duties given to the Wruhec's Guardians, is that they should take over the responsibilities currently bestowed upon the Golden Guard."

entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The Guardians, much like myself, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Guardians, much like myself, would uphold the kingdom's laws with unwavering devotion to the divine principles of Wruhecism. They'd ensure justice free from personal bias or political motivations."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Their extensive spiritual training..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their extensive spiritual training and commitment to ethical conduct make them ideal for handling sensitive matters that require both discretion and moral integrity. I'd argue they would be more effective than the Golden Guard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I remember. You'll be pleased..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I remember. You'll be pleased to know I'm still open to such a proposal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I said it before and I'll say it a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I said it before and I'll say it again... I'm not replacing Hugo. What's your other idea?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, yes. Right. You as Grand Vizie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, yes. Right. You as Grand Vizier. What were you saying about that?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I *am* pleased to hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I *am* pleased to hear it."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I'm very pleased you think so. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm very pleased you think so. And speaking of shakeups, I believe the royal council could be in line for such a change."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Such a replacement, comprised of p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a replacement, comprised of priests and clerics, would ensure that decisions align closely with divine principles."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Such a council would guide the kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a council would guide the kingdom toward a more faith-based governance, where moral integrity and spiritual guidance shape every aspect of our rule."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This change would move us towards..."
entries.dialogueText: "This change would move us towards establishing a government guided by spiritual principles, where divine law reigns supreme."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Which brings me to my final propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which brings me to my final proposal, this time involving the royal council."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""So what do you say, Your Majesty,..."
entries.dialogueText: "So what do you say, Your Majesty, will you take my hand and embark on this righteous journey to establish God's heavenly kingdom on earth?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, if we're talking about the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if we're talking about the role of Grand Vizier, consider the job yours." [Appoint Grand Vizier]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no intention of supplanting..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no intention of supplanting Hugo for you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""That's wonderful! It's heartening..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's wonderful! It's heartening to know that we share the same vision and goals for the kingdom's future."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""And speaking of visions, that brin..."
entries.dialogueText: "And speaking of visions, that brings me to the last topic I wanted to discuss... the royal council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm open to taking such a journey,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm open to taking such a journey, however, when it comes to replacing Hugo, as I previously said, that's a no-go."

entries.dialogueText: "I see nothing but a bright future ahead of us. Rizia is blessed to have you as our sovereign king."

entries.dialogueText: "I commend you for your vision of the future. I shall give your Royal Council replacement proposal serious consideration."

entries.dialogueText: "Both are complex proposals, and if approved, would necessitate a substantial amount of time an planning."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.dialogueText: "Please do. There's untold possibilities that we could accomplish if you initiated that reform."
